incident.what: Internal documents had been deleted from a public staging repository's working tree, but remained fully readable in its git history.
incident.signal: Found during a pre-publication audit of the history, not the tree.

root_cause: History was treated as an implementation detail. For a public repo, history is the product.

law.text: Internal files never enter a public staging repository, not even briefly. If one did, the history is rebuilt before publication; deleting the file is not a fix.
checks: pre-publish scan runs over all commits (git log -p), not only HEAD
any hit => history rewrite, not a deletion commit

notes: De-identified from a real operating incident. Names, systems and paths removed; the mechanism is kept.
